create-table-columns.sql: CREATE TABLE "app"."booking" ( "id" bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY (INCREMENT BY 2 NO MAXVALUE START WITH 10), "legacy" serial, "seats" smallint CONSTRAINT "seats_present" NOT NULL NO INHERIT DEFAULT 1 CONSTRAINT "seats_positive" CHECK ("seats" > 0) NOT ENFORCED, "note" text COLLATE "pg_catalog"."C" NULL, "price" decimal(10, 2) DEFAULT 9.50, "doubled" integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS ("seats" * 2) STORED, "halved" integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS ("seats" / 2) VIRTUAL, "serial" bigint GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY )

create-table-keys.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app"."booking" ( "id" bigint, "room" integer, "during" tstzrange, CONSTRAINT "booking_key" PRIMARY KEY ("id") INCLUDE ("room") DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT ("room", "id"), CONSTRAINT "no_double_booking" UNIQUE ("room", "during" WITHOUT OVERLAPS), CONSTRAINT "booking_room" FOREIGN KEY ("room", "id") REFERENCES "app"."room" ("id", "booking") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE SET NULL DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED NOT ENFORCED, FOREIGN KEY ("room", PERIOD "during") REFERENCES "app"."room" ("id", PERIOD "open"), CONSTRAINT "room_small" CHECK ("room" < 1000) NO INHERIT ENFORCED )

create-table-typed-columns.sql: CREATE TABLE "feeling" ( "mood" app.mood DEFAULT CAST('calm' AS app.mood), "moods" app.mood[], "tags" varchar(20)[], "span" app.floatrange, "token" uuid DEFAULT GEN_RANDOM_UUID() )

alter-table-actions.sql: ALTER TABLE "app"."booking" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "extra" text NOT NULL, DROP COLUMN "legacy", ADD CONSTRAINT "booking_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id"), ADD UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT ("room") NOT DEFERRABLE, ADD CONSTRAINT "room_fk" FOREIGN KEY ("room") REFERENCES "app"."room" ("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT NOT VALID, ADD CONSTRAINT "few_seats" CHECK ("seats" <= 9) NO INHERIT NOT VALID, ADD CONSTRAINT "note_present" NOT NULL "note" NO INHERIT NOT VALID, DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS "old" CASCADE, VALIDATE CONSTRAINT "room_fk", ALTER CONSTRAINT "room_fk" NOT ENFORCED, ALTER CONSTRAINT "note_present" INHERIT, ALTER COLUMN "doubled" SET EXPRESSION AS ("seats" * 3), ALTER COLUMN "halved" DROP EXPRESSION IF EXISTS

alter-table-modify-column.sql: ALTER TABLE "app"."booking" ALTER COLUMN "note" TYPE varchar COLLATE "C", ALTER COLUMN "note" SET DEFAULT 'none', ALTER COLUMN "note" SET NOT NULL, ALTER COLUMN "seats" DROP NOT NULL, ADD CONSTRAINT "room_present" NOT NULL "room", ALTER COLUMN "serial" ADD GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY (CACHE 5), ADD CHECK ("price" >= 0)

create-index-entries.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "booking_note" ON "app"."booking" ((LOWER("note")) "text_pattern_ops" DESC, "room", "id" ASC) INCLUDE ("seats") NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE "seats" > 0 AND (NOT "room" IS NULL)

create-composite.sql: CREATE TYPE "pair" AS ("a" integer, "b" text COLLATE "pg_catalog"."C", "c" app.mood)

create-range.sql: CREATE TYPE "app"."floatrange" AS RANGE (SUBTYPE = double precision, SUBTYPE_OPCLASS = "float8_ops", SUBTYPE_DIFF = "float8mi", MULTIRANGE_TYPE_NAME = "app"."floatmultirange")

create-text-range.sql: CREATE TYPE "textrange" AS RANGE (SUBTYPE = text, COLLATION = "C")

alter-composite.sql: ALTER TYPE "pair" ADD ATTRIBUTE "d" bigint CASCADE, ADD ATTRIBUTE "e" text COLLATE "C" CASCADE, DROP ATTRIBUTE IF EXISTS "a" CASCADE, DROP ATTRIBUTE "b" CASCADE, ALTER ATTRIBUTE "c" TYPE text COLLATE "C" CASCADE, ALTER ATTRIBUTE "d" TYPE integer CASCADE

rename-attribute.sql: ALTER TYPE "pair" RENAME ATTRIBUTE "a" TO "z" RESTRICT

create-sequence.sql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS "app"."ticket" AS integer INCREMENT BY 5 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9007199254740991 START WITH -3 CACHE 2 CYCLE OWNED BY "app"."booking"."id"

alter-sequence.sql: ALTER SEQUENCE IF EXISTS "ticket" AS bigint NO CYCLE RESTART WITH 100 OWNED BY NONE

create-extension.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "btree_gist" WITH SCHEMA "public" VERSION '1.7' CASCADE

comment-on-table.sql: COMMENT ON TABLE "app"."booking" IS 'Rooms booked, and when'

comment-on-column.sql:
COMMENT ON COLUMN "app"."booking"."note" IS E'it''s a \\ note
over two lines'
